name: Scene Labels
description: Works out what is in each shot — people, animals, vehicles and everyday objects — so you can find the moments you want.
details: YOLOX-Tiny object detection in ONNX, COCO's 80 everyday classes. Drift samples a few frames of each detected shot and labels it, so scenes can be searched and ranked by what is in them. Package id: object.yolox-tiny.
author: CutWire
